class IEEE1722DatagramNTSCF final :
protected IEEE1722Datagram
AVTPDUCommonHeaderFields {...};
Description:
This class defines an object which represents the IEEE1722 definded subtype NTSCF header
fields. Payload (data) is derived from class IEEE1722Datagram. Payload represents the
IEEE1722 defined acf_payload_data. The data length is defined by the member variable ntscf_
data_length.
